subject: Heritage Hall aisle flow + kickstand banner assembly plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, expo-ops@heritagevenue.com
Date: 2026-12-12T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Heritage Hall aisle flow + kickstand banner assembly plan

Team — attaching the latest Heritage Hall floorplan (v4) and the kickstand banner specs from Atlas. Venue came back with a couple of constraints that impact placement: a 6ft clear aisle on Aisle D and a no-staging zone near dock B between 10:00–13:00 on load-in day.

Primary asks:
- Confirm whether we keep the kickstand banners in the two corner sightlines or consolidate to the single island center (saves freight & install time).
- Approve a rollcase inventory split — we should keep 2 demo rollcases on the booth and 1 backstock at the crate room. Inventory attached.
- If we consolidate banners, I want procurement to push Atlas to revise the mounting plates to low-profile (see kickstand_specs_ATLAS_v2.pdf).

I'll loop in Heritage ops for staging windows but want internal alignment first. Can you each reply with your preference by EOD Tuesday?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0139

Attachments: heritage_floorplan_v4.pdf (application/pdf), kickstand_specs_ATLAS_v2.pdf (application/pdf), rollcase_inventory_2026-12-10.csv (text/csv)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Heritage Hall aisle flow + kickstand banner assembly plan

Marissa — thanks for the plan and files. Quick replies: 

- Preference: consolidate to single island center. Fewer banners = faster install and lower risk given the aisle clearance.
- Rollcase split: agree with 2 on-booth, 1 backstock. Add a labeled crate for spare power cables and dongles (we burned time last quarter looking for chargers).
- Procurement: I'll contact Atlas and ask for the low-profile mounting plate quote + lead time. If they can turn in <72 hours we keep the consolidated approach; if >72 hours we should keep the two corner banners and reorder mounting plates after the show.

I'll draft an email to Atlas and Heritage ops and paste the vendor replies into this thread.

-naomi
Naomi Feldman
Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwoodinference.com

From: expo-ops@heritagevenue.com <expo-ops@heritagevenue.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: orders@atlassign.com
Date: 2026-12-13T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Heritage Hall aisle flow + kickstand banner assembly plan

Hi Marissa / Naomi — thanks for the updated floorplan. A couple of clarifications from Heritage operations: 

1) Aisle D clearance: the 6ft rule is firm — any display projecting into the aisle will be flagged during the inspection.
2) Load-in window: Dock B is occupied 10:00–13:00 for a scheduled freight move (we can reserve Dock C for your larger crates).
3) Power: On-floor power drops are limited; you can bring battery kits but must register them.

We support consolidation to the center island if you keep banner footprints to 2' x 4' and low-profile mounts (max projection 4\" from the base). If Atlas provides those specs we can pre-approve to speed the booth check-in.

Attached: brief hall rules doc and a stamped copy of the v4 plan with the no-staging zone highlighted.

- Heritage Ops
Heritage Hall Event Services
expo-ops@heritagevenue.com

Attachments referenced: heritage_hall_rules.pdf, heritage_floorplan_v4_stamped.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, orders@atlassign.com <orders@atlassign.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T17:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Heritage Hall aisle flow + kickstand banner assembly plan

Team and Atlas — summary & decision: 

1) We will consolidate to the single island center and order two low-profile kickstand banners (2' x 4') per Heritage ops constraints.
2) Rollcase plan: 2 on-booth, 1 backstock in crate room at Dock C (confirmed with Heritage). Marcus — please label the spare crate with “REDWOOD ELECTRICAL & DONGLES.”
3) Atlas — please send final mounting-plate spec sheet and expedited quote. We need proof of low-profile (<=4\") and a production lead time estimate. If lead <= 72 hours we proceed with Atlas; if not, we will order temporary corner banners from local vendor and process Atlas as post-show replacement.
4) Naomi — please register our battery kits with Heritage and add the power cable kit to the rollcase packing list.

Please reply with a short OK or any blocking issues by EOD tomorrow so I can finalize the purchase order and shipping labels.

Thanks —
Marissa
